Sanofi’s unsolicited, non-binding $52.50 per share proposal reached Medivation on 04/15/2016, was announced on 04/28/2016 and rejected on 04/29/2016, and Sanofi then began a consent solicitation to replace the board. Pfizer expressed interest from 05/02/2016; on 06/28/2016 Medivation’s bankers, J.P. Morgan and Evercore, approached it, Pfizer signed a confidentiality and standstill agreement on 06/29/2016, and on 07/05/2016 Medivation announced agreements with several parties, including Sanofi, which agreed to withdraw its consent solicitation. After data-room access and a management presentation, the bankers asked for non-binding preliminary proposals on 08/08/2016, when Pfizer offered $65.00 per share in cash. On 08/10/2016 Medivation invited Pfizer and several other interested parties to a second round and then asked for merger-agreement mark-ups by 08/18/2016 and definitive proposals by 08/19/2016, when Pfizer offered $77.00. The bankers then asked for Pfizer’s best and final offer by the afternoon of 08/20/2016; Pfizer offered $81.50 in cash, Medivation’s board approved, and the parties signed that afternoon and announced the deal on 08/22/2016. This filing is Pfizer’s offer to purchase and reports no offers from the other participants.
